figures.shows: The output of the editor run headless for 120 frames from a terminal and left alone (no Ctrl+C): its log lines, one per line, with the time, the level and the message
figures.caption: Left alone (no Ctrl+C), a headless editor logs into the terminal and ends after its last frame without a warning; the shell, not the log, reports its exit code. Strata logs the engine's lines, App the editor's. Times, port and start time vary and show as …; threads and graphics device are the book machine's.
figures.alt: Lines of text from a terminal, each with a time (left out here), a level, the logger's name and a message. They give the editor's version, engine modules, threads, graphics device and automation port, then the lines that close the run.
